text_en: An account of the genealogy of Jesus the Messiah, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
text_cn: 亚巴郎之子，达味之子耶稣基督的族谱：

text_en: Abraham was the father of Isaac, and Isaac the father of Jacob, and Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers,
text_cn: 亚巴郎生依撒格，依撒格生雅各伯，雅各伯生犹大和他的兄弟们；

text_en: and Judah the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar, and Perez the father of Hezron, and Hezron the father of Aram,
text_cn: 犹大由塔玛尔生培勒兹和则辣黑，培勒兹生赫兹龙，赫兹龙生阿兰，

text_en: and Aram the father of Aminadab, and Aminadab the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon the father of Salmon,
text_cn: 阿兰生阿米纳达布，阿米纳达布生纳赫雄，纳赫雄生撒耳孟，

text_en: and Salmon the father of Boaz by Rahab, and Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth, and Obed the father of Jesse,
text_cn: 撒耳孟由辣哈布生波阿次，波阿次由卢德生敖贝得，敖贝得生叶瑟，

text_en: and Jesse the father of King David. And David was the father of Solomon by the wife of Uriah,
text_cn: 叶瑟生达味王。达味由乌黎雅的妻子生撒罗满，

text_en: and Solomon the father of Rehoboam, and Rehoboam the father of Abijah, and Abijah the father of Asaph,
text_cn: 撒罗满生勒哈贝罕，勒哈贝罕生阿彼雅，阿彼雅生阿撒，

text_en: and Asaph the father of Jehoshaphat, and Jehoshaphat the father of Joram, and Joram the father of Uzziah,
text_cn: 阿撒生约沙法特，约沙法特生约兰，约兰生乌齐雅，

text_en: and Uzziah the father of Jotham, and Jotham the father of Ahaz, and Ahaz the father of Hezekiah,
text_cn: 乌齐雅生约堂，约堂生阿哈次，阿哈次生希则克雅，

text_en: and Hezekiah the father of Manasseh, and Manasseh the father of Amos, and Amos the father of Josiah,
text_cn: 希则克雅生默纳舍，默纳舍生阿孟，阿孟生约史雅，

text_en: and Josiah the father of Jechoniah and his brothers, at the time of the deportation to Babylon.
text_cn: 约史雅在巴比伦流徙期间生耶苛尼雅和他的兄弟们。

text_en: And after the deportation to Babylon: Jechoniah was the father of Salathiel, and Salathiel the father of Zerubbabel,
text_cn: 流徙巴比伦以后，耶苛尼雅生沙耳提耳，沙耳提耳生则鲁巴贝耳，

text_en: and Zerubbabel the father of Abiud, and Abiud the father of Eliakim, and Eliakim the father of Azor,
text_cn: 则鲁巴贝耳生阿彼乌得，阿彼乌得生厄里雅金，厄里雅金生阿左尔。

text_en: and Azor the father of Zadok, and Zadok the father of Achim, and Achim the father of Eliud,
text_cn: 阿左尔生匝多克，匝多克生阿歆（xīn），阿歆生厄里乌得，

text_en: and Eliud the father of Eleazar, and Eleazar the father of Matthan, and Matthan the father of Jacob,
text_cn: 厄里乌得生厄肋阿匝尔，厄肋阿匝尔生玛堂，玛堂生雅各伯，

text_en: and Jacob the father of Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom Jesus was born, who is called the Messiah.
text_cn: 雅各伯生若瑟，玛利亚的丈夫，玛利亚生耶稣，他称为基督。

text_en: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David to the deportation to Babylon, fourteen generations; and from the deportation to Babylon to the Messiah, fourteen generations.
text_cn: 所以从亚巴郎到达味共十四代，从达味到流徙巴比伦共十四代，从流徙巴比伦到基督共十四代。

text_en: Now the birth of Jesus the Messiah took place in this way. When his mother Mary had been engaged to Joseph, but before they lived together, she was found to be with child from the Holy Spirit.
text_cn: 耶稣基督的诞生是这样的：他的母亲玛利亚许配于若瑟后，在同居前，她因圣神有孕的事已显示出来。

text_en: Her husband Joseph, being a righteous man and unwilling to expose her to public disgrace, planned to dismiss her quietly.
text_cn: 她的丈夫若瑟，因是义人，不愿公开羞辱她，有意暗暗地休退她。

text_en: But just when he had resolved to do this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife, for the child conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.
text_cn: 当他在思虑这事时，看，在梦中上主的天使显现给他说：“达味之子若瑟，不要怕娶你的妻子玛利亚，因为那在她内受生的，是出于圣神。

text_en: She will bear a son, and you are to name him Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins.”
text_cn: 她要生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫耶稣，因为他要把自己的民族，由他们的罪恶中拯救出来。”

text_en: All this took place to fulfill what had been spoken by the Lord through the prophet:
text_cn: 这一切事的发生，是为应验上主藉先知所说的话：

text_en: “Look, the virgin shall conceive and bear a son,    and they shall name him Emmanuel,” which means, “God is with us.”
text_cn: “看，一位贞女，将怀孕生子，人将称他的名字为厄玛奴耳，意思是：天主与我们同在。

text_en: When Joseph awoke from sleep, he did as the angel of the Lord commanded him; he took her as his wife,
text_cn: 若瑟从睡梦中醒来，就照上主的天使所嘱咐的办了，娶了他的妻子；

text_en: but had no marital relations with her until she had borne a son; and he named him Jesus.
text_cn: 若瑟虽然没有认识她，她就生了一个儿子，给他起名叫耶稣。
